Definition: perhaps from G1210 and πόσις (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"):--Lord, master.
BiblicalUsage: A master is the one with absolute right over a household, and Scripture gives the title to God and to Christ. Simeon calls God Master when he holds the child Jesus, the church prays to the Sovereign Lord who made heaven and earth, and Peter and Jude warn of those who deny the only Lord God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe calling God Master is the other side of calling Him Father. He rules absolutely and He loves perfectly, so His mastery is not a burden to escape but a shelter to live under.
